title: CBTC: Communications-Based Train Control
summary: An MTA video on communications-based train control, the system meant to replace the New York City subway's century-old signaling. It also shows the mechanical interlocks and signals in use today.
why: Cited as a view into how outdated and error-prone NYC subway signaling is, and how antique interlocking systems work.

quote.text: Well made video that helps understand the interlocks - if you like antique systems!
